# test-repo

A legal-AI tool for contract review.

## Usage

This tool supports contract review and clause extraction.

## Examples

### Contract Review

```
Review the following contract clause and identify potential risks:

[CONTRACT TEXT HERE]

Provide a structured analysis with: 1) Risk summary 2) Specific clauses of concern.
```
